sub_parameters.name: ComponentType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the application sub-component.

For Supabase, valid values are:

- gateway

- backend

sub_parameters.name: ScaleMax
sub_parameters.description: The maximum number of PCUs for a single node. Valid values: 0 to 16.

sub_parameters.name: ScaleMin
sub_parameters.description: The minimum number of PolarDB Capacity Units (PCUs) for a single node. Valid values: 0 to 16.
